description: The strip of the document region shown while a historical version is previewed (redesign 146c7e1b, phase 6, DE-2.5): 'You are viewing version X' with 'Return to current' and 'Restore'. Restore asks inline - a question and Restore / Cancel replace the two buttons - instead of a dialog. It belongs to the document, so it stays visible with the version panel closed. Renders nothing while PreviewVersion is null.

parameters.name: PreviewVersion
parameters.description: The version being previewed; the strip renders nothing while this is null.

parameters.name: OnReturnToCurrent
parameters.description: Raised when the preview should return to the current document.

parameters.name: OnRestoreVersion
parameters.description: Raised when the reader confirmed that the previewed version becomes the current draft.
